facts.fact: Flutterwave says the Reserve Bank of Malawi granted it an International Money Transfer Operator licence on 19 October 2023.

MWI.note: Only the provider's own claims on security; no rules or complaints body.

facts.fact: Flutterwave says the Reserve Bank of Malawi licensed it on 19 October 2023 as an international money transfer operator to process remittances into Malawi through its Send App.

MWI.note: Nothing on government payments to people.
No survey share of adults with accounts.
No mobile money or retail service in Malawi is stated.
Nothing on tax or fee payment.
